text.description_html:
Acorn RZ3BD, Rough Black Iron Eqius Leverset With Round Rose

Made out of iron, this lever latch features the decorative X's on the handle. It will fit all standard pre-drilled doors and has a lifetime no-rust warranty. The finish is rough, mimicking the texture of naturally weathered iron. It is available in dummy, passage, and privacy functions for doors with 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backsets and 1-3/8" to 1-3/4" thick.

Features and Specifications of the Rough Iron Lever Set:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Front: 1" x 2-1/4"
  • Depth of Mortise: 3-5/8"
  • Fits all standard pre-drilled doors: 2-1/8" crossbores, 1" edgebores
  • Recommended for interior use. These latch sets are not designed for heavy doors, but may be extended for certain thicker doors.

When Selecting a Function:

  • Half Dummy: A stationary lever for use as a pull or to match trim on one side of door. Includes 1 lever, 1 rose, and mounting screws.
  • Passage Set (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.
  • Privacy Set (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior lever engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior lever. Complete set - 2 levers, 2 roses, privacy button, door latch, strike plate, dust box, faceplate, spindle, and mounting screws.

Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!
